components.name: Agenda
components.summary: Commits per day across every project iboard supervises, so you can see at a glance when work happened, on what, and open any day to read its commits.

components.name: BoardHoldingCmd
components.summary: The board after ⌘ alone has been held for hint-hold 0.5s.

components.name: BoardScreen
components.summary: The board at rest, the screen iboard opens on.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Buttons are 24pt-tall verbs.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A 14pt checkbox with a line-strong edge and a 12pt label, used in Settings › General, for instance for Auto (reload from disk and save as you type).

components.name: Column
components.summary: One column per folder: todo/, ready/, doing/, done/.

components.name: DesignPanel
components.summary: The project's design system, browsed in egui.

components.name: DropZones
components.summary: Two large drop targets, Archive and Delete, one at a time, that slide up from the bottom of the board only while a card is being dragged.

components.name: Editor
components.summary: The same page in plain text: the raw file, in edit-body mono, inside an accent 2pt frame that says "you are editing".

components.name: FilterField
components.summary: The board's filter in the header: compact at rest, wide while you use it, with one-click keyword suggestions for the filters people use most.

components.summary: The General tab of the Settings dialog (⌘,), first of five: General, AI review, AI build, Titles, Labels.

components.name: GroupsDialog
components.summary: Creates and edits project groups.

components.name: HeaderBar
components.summary: The one top bar: bar-h 40pt, bg ground, a line rule below.

components.name: Icons
components.summary: The line icons iboard draws on the 24pt grid: 14pt in buttons and card actions, 18pt in the Delete and Archive drop zones, always currentColor with round caps…

components.name: IssueCard
components.summary: An issue on the board: its labels, the file's first heading as title, its first paragraph as summary.

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: A key cap: meta-mono (JetBrains Mono Medium 11/14) in ink-muted on a surface-sunken fill, radius-sm, padding 1×4.

components.name: Label
components.summary: A short tag that groups issues, read straight from the title.

components.name: LabelPicker
components.summary: A small popover that adds labels to one issue without opening the Editor.

components.name: Logo
components.summary: An i whose dot is a card.

components.name: MarginComment
components.summary: A note the author leaves on one block of the Reader, for the next AI review.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: One frame for everything that stops the board until you answer it: a confirmation, a settings form, a document, or a work surface where you and an agent write…

components.name: NewIssueModal
components.summary: Where a new issue gets written: a large modal over the board, with your notes on the left and the issue file, exactly as it will be written, on the right.

components.name: PaneDivider
components.summary: The resize handle between two panes side by side (Reader and Agent log, Reader and Review panel, the two panes of RefinePanel).

components.name: ProjectMenu
components.summary: The menu under the header's project name and path, top left of the Board: pick a group (each group is its own board: its projects seen as one) or a single proj…

components.name: QuickAdd
components.summary: An inline composer at the top of the Todo column.

components.name: Reader

components.name: ReaderScreen
components.summary: The Reader at rest: header (Board, breadcrumb with the column's status icon, the Edit, Add label and Delete icons, the AI split button, …), the sheet (labels,…

components.name: RefinePanel
components.summary: The dialog where a refinement agent (the Challenger) pushes back on an issue and offers numbered ways to resolve it.

components.name: ReviewButton
components.summary: The entry point to ask an agent (OpenCode, Claude Code or a custom command) to challenge an issue.

components.name: ReviewPanel
components.summary: The result of a review: a 360pt panel beside the Reader or Editor page with three findings in a fixed order.

components.name: ReviewSettings
components.summary: The AI review tab of the Settings dialog: which agent runs the AI review, and with which model.

components.name: Scrollbar
components.summary: One overlay scrollbar for every scrolling pane (Reader sheet, Editor, a column, the RefinePanel reasoning, popup lists).

components.name: SettingsLabels
components.summary: The Labels tab of the Settings dialog (⌘,), last of five: General, AI review, AI build, Titles, Labels.

components.name: Skeleton

components.name: StatsScreen
components.summary: The maintenance view of one project.

components.name: StatusBar
components.summary: A 24pt strip at the bottom of the window in meta (Inter 12/16), ink-muted on bg, with a line rule above.

components.name: StatusPill
components.summary: An 18pt pill with a dot and a word, outlined in its state color on surface.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: The filter input: 24pt tall, line-strong border, ink text, ink-faint placeholder.

components.name: Thinking
components.summary: What iboard shows while an agent works, usually around 10s for a Challenger round.

components.name: TitleSettings
components.summary: The Titles tab of the Settings dialog: which engine names new issues from their description.
